szoveg_eredeti:
Season 2 of the Chroma Awards (@chromaawards) is here, in partnership with Kling AI!

With $1M+ in promotional opportunities, $450K+ in cash prizes, and student internships up for grabs, this season brings even more opportunities for AI creators to showcase their work.

Compete in any of our five divisions: Film & TV, Ads, Music Videos, Games, and Behind-the-Scenes.

Use Kling AI in your submission and share your work on social media to unlock additional prizes and perks.

Submissions are now open through January 7:
http://submit.chromaawards.com/go/kling
